name: Set Cardinality Constraint
description: Reframe the boolean clauses as a requirement that the set of values assigned to the two constrained variables has a cardinality of exactly 2. Since the domain is restricted to {1, 2}, this perfectly and unambiguously enforces $h_u \neq h_v$, which is the core of bipartite coloring. However, it removes all boolean logic and graph terminology, forcing models to independently deduce the reduction to bipartiteness.
